22/11/25   1015  
Telehealth video consult  
GP in Brisbane  pt in remote AMS clinic room AHW present  

Reason  
F/U lung lesion ?abscess on recent CT post hosp  

ID  
54yo Aboriginal woman community health worker  

Subjective / HPI  
Recent admit regional hosp 10/7 for LLL pneumonia with cavitating lesion on CT  
Dx there as probable lung abscess  
Had IV pip/tazo then oral Augmentin Duo Forte on d/c  

Today  
Says feels "mostly alright now just abit chesty"  
Cough still productive esp am yellow sputum nil haemoptysis since d/c  
Mild L lower chest twinge only on big breath or hard cough nil sig pleuritic pain  
SOB only if walks fast to bus can do light housework now  
Nil current fevers or rigors mild fatigue ↓appetite improving est wt ↓2–3kg over ~4/52  
Nil night sweats nil calf pain/swelling  

Pt wonders if dusty aircon @work or lying down after big feed might have contributed  

Meds (per pt + MyHR)  
Augmentin Duo Forte 875/125 BD currently day 7/10  
Prednisolone 10mg mane long term for polymyalgia type condition rheum r/v booked next mth  
Pantoprazole 40mg mane  
Paracetamol 1g PRN up to QID using 1–2/d  
Nil reg inhalers  NKDA  

PMHx  
Chronic steroid use immune compromise prev shingles  
?borderline BSLs in past nil formal DM dx  
GORD  

Social  
Lives remote with extended family cares for grandkids  
Non smoker occasional ETOH  
Transport to imaging difficult relies on community / family  

Carer / AHW input  
AHW says family a bit worried she "doesnt like to say when shes crook" tends to push on with work  

Telehealth exam  
Gen alert speaking full sentences looks slightly tired not toxic  
Colour ok nil obvious cyanosis  
Resp RR 18 on obs from clinic occasional wet cough on call nil ↑WOB  
CVS appears comfortable  
Gait walked a few steps in room steady nil obvious SOB  
Vitals (clinic)  
BP 126/78 HR 84 reg Temp 36.8 SpO₂ 96% RA  

Ix reviewed (MyHR)  
CT chest 10/7  
LLL cavitating lesion ~3.5cm with air fluid level surrounding consolidation c/w lung abscess post pneumonia  
Nil clear mass nil mediastinal LAD nil empyema  
Rec rpt imaging 4–6/52 to ensure resolution / exclude underlying malignancy  
CXR prior LLL consolidation ?cavity  
Bloods in hosp WCC 15→9.8 CRP 180→45 U&E LFTs essentially N blood cultures x2 NG  

Assessment  
1 Lung abscess LLL post pneumonia improving clinically on oral abx vitals stable O2 sats N  high risk due to chronic steroids  malignancy less likely given acute course + response but cannot fully exclude until rpt CT  
2 Immune compromise 2° long term pred  ↑risk complicated infection  
3 GORD  poss aspiration risk esp lying flat after meals currently on PPI  
4 Access / remote context  will need support for imaging transport telehealth f/u  

Plan  
1 Lung abscess  
- Complete current 10/7 Augmentin course as per hosp  
- Extend oral abx due to abscess + steroids  
  → new script Augmentin Duo Forte 875/125 BD further 4/52 PBS  
- Rpt CT chest with contrast in ~4–6/52 request sent to nearest radiology via clinic fax  AHW to assist booking + transport  
- If rpt CT shows persistent cavity or ?underlying lesion → resp ref public clinic ± bronchoscopy  

Safety net  
Advised urgent ED / 000 if  
fever or rigors recur  
↑SOB esp with simple tasks or cant speak full sentences  
worsening or sharp pleuritic chest pain  
coughing up blood  
feeling much more unwell confused or very weak  
Reinforced she is not "a bother" given steroids low threshold to present family encouraged to bring her in early  

2 Immune compromise / steroids  
- Continue pred 10mg mane as per rheum plan nil change today  
- Reinforced infection risk early r/v if any deterioration  

3 GORD / aspiration  
- Continue pantoprazole 40mg mane  
- Simple advice avoid lying flat straight after big meals head of bed slightly elevated  

4 Monitoring / tests  
- Path form to local clinic for 1/7  
  FBC CRP U&E LFTs while on prolonged abx  
- Nurse / AHW to recheck BP HR SpO₂ at same visit  

5 Preventive / chronic issues (deferred today time)  
- To address next longer appt  
  long term steroid mgmt bone health DEXA  
  vaccines pneumo flu COVID booster  
  DM screen given borderline BSL hx  

Follow up  
- Telehealth r/v 1/7 after bloods booked via clinic  
- Telehealth again ~5–6/52 once CT done to discuss results  
- Earlier in person / ED if red flags as above or if AHW/family concerned  

Billing  
Telehealth Level C equiv  bulk billed  

[Addendum 24/11/25 1630 – Dr Lee]  
Spoke briefly with AHW by phone  CT booking made for 5/52 transport arranged via community bus  plan unchanged
